text:
alisha: Quick heads up — Q2 pricing experiment going live next week. Need last-minute vendor rate confirmation and run of the invoice reconciliation sim for the A/B cohorts. CC @ben @dmitri @emma. Attached simulated_usage.csv (see snippet below).

alisha: simulated_usage.csv (first 3 rows):
```
account_id,cohort,month_tokens
acct_102,A,125000
acct_211,B,43000
acct_403,A,98000
```

ben: What's the cohort split again? 70/30? And do we apply grandfathering to existing subscriptions?

dmitri: 60/40 in the simulation (we tested both). SQL I ran:
```
SELECT cohort, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM usage
WHERE date >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY cohort;
```
Full results in GCS: gs://redwood-experiments/pricing/q2-run-03.csv

emma: For billing, grandfathering only applies to subscriptions created before 2026-04-01. For invoices, if a customer hits the old tier mid-billing-cycle we prorate. Any exceptions need approval.

alisha: Correct. We propose soft-grandfathering: keep rate for 30 days post-rollout, then shift. This avoids invoice spikes. Is that okay with Revenue Ops?

ben: ok with 30d, but need net revenue delta estimate. dmitri can you add a column with projected MRR delta and worst-case invoice credit exposure?

dmitri: On it. Quick preview:
```
cohort,projected_mrr_delta,est_credit_exposure
A,-12500,2100
B,8400,600
```
That's with 70/30 split and 30d grandfathering.

alisha: @vendor_ops — do vendor rates allow temporary discounts? We might need to pass through credits.

vendor_ops: Spoke with vendor; they can support a one-off credit program but it's limited to 5% of month's spend per account. They need a PO amendment. ETA 48h.

emma: If vendor cap < estimated credits, we'll absorb remainder. Need finance sign-off on buffer. @ben please confirm budget.

ben: Confirmed budget of $25k for transition credits. Can we limit support to accounts > $1k/mo to reduce exposure?

alisha: Yes, let's add an eligibility filter: accounts with >$1k ARR and active usage last 30d. Also add a 2-week notice email. I'll draft messaging.

billing-bot: Reminder — 12 invoices from pilot cohort are pending dispute flags. Run reconciliation script: `./scripts/recon-invoices --cohort A --output /tmp/recon.csv`

dmitri: Running recon now, will push results to the sheet and ping when done.

alisha: Thank you. Final ask — can someone ack/approve vendor PO amendment when it's ready? I'll drop draft into #finance tomorrow. :pray:

ben: Ack. :thumbsup:

vendor_ops: Will circulate PO draft, tagging legal.
